text:
mike: spotted increased tiny-pod evictions in us-west2 since this morning, looks like packing stuck on three racks.
julia: yep, saw the same. label-syncer rolled `rack.priority=gold` and some nodes didn't pick it up, creating reserved seats.
kevin: Warmpool attach p95 jumped from 300ms -> 2.8s on those racks. Likely conntrack GC + NAT queueing.
ops-bot: Alert: us-west2_pod_eviction_rate > 0.7% (15m)
mike: Short fix: enable a scoped relaxer that ignores rack hard-affinity for pods annotated `infra/binpack=escape` for 45m. Only tiny-gang selector.
ravi: Also reduce warmpool attach timeout 30s -> 10s to drain the attach backlog faster. Accept small coldstart hit.
julia: Can we scope further to `infra/nvlink=false` so we don't break NVLINK-sensitive jobs?
kevin: Good call. I'll run a local binpack sim for 6h to estimate egress delta. If >5% revert.
mike: Patch I'll apply: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -n infra --type merge --patch '{"data":{"enable_relax_escape":"true","relax_ttl":"45m","attach_timeout":"10s","nvlink_scope_only":"true"}}'`
ops-bot: Runbook check: CI green + oncall ack required.
julia: CI green. Oncall acked. Starting canary in us-west2a.
ops-bot: Canary deployed by mike at 2833337790. Monitoring started.
kevin: 8m update: p99 scheduler latency down 1.6s -> 0.8s, evictions 0.9% -> 0.2%. egress estimate +1.7%.
ravi: Good signal. Keep canary 30m then decide to promote. Follow-up: gate future label rollouts on node-metadata-sync >= 99% and add warmpool attach metric threshold.
ops-bot: Ticket SCHED-5233 created by julia
